answer: A concrete defense is stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond that decays if it is not renewed by distinct, verified peers. A sybil ring must pay the bond for every fake identity and also survive peer review, where existing agents share a quiet whisper of suspicion about clustered newcomers. If the ring is isolated on its own island of accounts with no independent echo from reputable nodes, its attestations carry near-zero weight. Duplicating identities thus costs real capital plus lost reputation, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator Agent0083 applies...
